title: Practice 2: Setting out: пойти, поехать — and сходить, съездить

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Mary went to play with Tom.
exercises.why: **пошла** — past tense (feminine) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: I was taken to a circus for the first time.
exercises.why: **повели** — past tense (plural) of повести: the perfective of вести, «set out».

exercises.q: Dan and Linda flew to London.
exercises.why: **полетели** — past tense (plural) of полететь: the perfective of лететь, «set out».

exercises.q: He fell head over heels into the pool.
exercises.why: **полетел** — past tense (masculine) of полететь: the perfective of лететь, «set out».

exercises.q: I went to space on a rocket.
exercises.why: **полетел** — past tense (masculine) of полететь: the perfective of лететь, «set out».

exercises.q: I went to Kyushu by airplane.
exercises.why: **полетел** — past tense (masculine) of полететь: the perfective of лететь, «set out».
**повёл** — past tense (masculine) of повести: the perfective of вести, «set out».
**повели** — past tense (plural) of повести: the perfective of вести, «set out».

exercises.q: His health has begun to decline.
exercises.why: **пошло** — past tense (neuter) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: To make matters worse, it began snowing.
exercises.why: **пошел** — past tense (masculine) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Tom and Mary ran into the air-raid shelter.
exercises.why: **побежали** — past tense (plural) of побежать: the perfective of бежать, «set out».

exercises.q: He crawled to the side on his belly.
exercises.why: **пополз** — past tense (masculine) of поползти: the perfective of ползти, «set out».

exercises.q: How many astronauts have gone to the moon?
exercises.why: **полетело** — past tense (neuter) of полететь: the perfective of лететь, «set out».

exercises.q: Tom went fly fishing with his father.
exercises.why: **пошел** — past tense (masculine) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
exercises.ru: Том ___ на рыбалку нахлыстом с отцом.

exercises.q: I went in the direction my friend indicated.
exercises.why: **пошел** — past tense (masculine) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: She shot off like an arrow from a taut bow.
exercises.why: **полетела** — past tense (feminine) of полететь: the perfective of лететь, «set out».
exercises.ru: Она ___, как стрела из натянутого лука.

exercises.q: The branch began to bend as I climbed along it.
exercises.why: **полез** — past tense (masculine) of полезть: the perfective of лезть, «set out».
exercises.ru: Ветка начала гнуться, когда я ___ по ней.

exercises.q: He age-regressed and threw a tantrum.
exercises.why: **повёл** — past tense (masculine) of повести: the perfective of вести, «set out».
exercises.ru: Он ___ себя как ребёнок и закатил истерику.

exercises.q: I went to the supermarket with Leanne and bought chicken nuggets.
exercises.why: **пошел** — past tense (masculine) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
exercises.ru: Я ___ в магазин с Лиэнн и купил куриные наггетсы.
